name: bluesky_reply
description: Reply to a Bluesky post chosen by ref (from bluesky_timeline) with your reply text. The reply is bound to exactly the ref you name — no URL is copied, so it cannot land on the wrong post. Pass the ref of the post your text is actually about.

inputs.name: post_ref
inputs.description: The [bN] ref of the post to reply to (e.g. 'b1').

outputs.description: Echo-back of the post replied to and the reply text, plus the new post uri.
